description: The canonical planner arm (Model B) on RackToServing3D: tossing3d-canonical's shared values verbatim except the cost file, which prices the rack's two human skills (human_batch_return, human_tool_recovery) at 5 each instead of Tossing3D's two cube resets. Tossing3D's layout/evaluation-layout have no rack equivalent and are not set. Step protocol only: give --practice-step-budget. Expectimax callers pass --pomdp-search-depth 6 themselves.
